scenarios.name: Refinery Seizure
scenarios.rules: The centre objective is worth 2 VP.

scenarios.name: Surveyor Escort
scenarios.rules: Attacker's surveyor token moves 2 hexes when an adjacent friendly war-walker spends 1 Pressure. Attacker scores 6 VP if it exits the far edge. It has 3 hit points, TN 4 and no armour; destroying it gives the defender 4 VP.
